$comment: Resilience IQ obligation layer (DESIGN.md section 7; owner default Q14: Resilience-owned file read with Sovereign IQ conditions.ts). Validated against docs/cio-readiness/resilience-iq/design/obligation.schema.json in test/resilience-iq-content.test.ts. Answer labels are the v1 option labels for kept questions and the v2 labels in DESIGN.md section 12 for reworded and new questions, except EX-09, whose labels are reworded so they pass the language lint (the labels name the retention lock behind immutability, and the v1 word for a usable backup is on the shared banned list): owner decision recorded in PLAN.md RQ2; RQ3 binds them to the v2 question bank and a test then fails on any label not in the bank. Status shown to the client is always "Indicative status from your answers; not a compliance opinion." Not legal advice; counsel review before external use (RQ11).

applicability.note: Entities under the simplified framework of Art. 16(1) are outside Art. 11-12 (REG-02 option proposed: dora_art16_simplified; owner decision). Microenterprise carve-outs are per obligation (REG-02 dora_microenterprise).
